text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Hey, Ai-chan.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ever since that day, when you ran with 
that brilliant sparkle.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ever since that day, when she gave me a 
dream in a world where I could no longer 
see a future.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: You are my hope.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Faster and stronger than anyone else, a 
girl destined to shine brighter than 
anyone in the world: Ai-chan. For someone 
like you to—"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I hope we can stay happy forever and ever.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: That's why... I'm—!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: A ge—ni—us, a geni—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...A true genius!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I'm a geniuuuuuuuuuuuuuuus!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: “The winner is— Fusaichi Paaaandoraaaa!!”
(Uwooooooooah!!!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Haa, hah――...?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: —Pandora! Pandora! Pandora! Pandora!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Pandora! Pandora! Pandora! Pandora!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ... I feel like I'm—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...A "genius"...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Fusaichi Pandora~!! You're the absolute 
best!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, amazing! I saw something amazing! 
Pandora! Pandora! Pandoooraaa!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Hahh... This view is...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Miss Pandora!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I... I will—!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I will keep on winning!! By believing in 
myself!!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Just like you—without fail!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ………………――Hehe, ehehe……! Ehehehehe!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Yup♡

Cheers reverberated throughout the 
racecourse. Together with the chants 
praising her—

The Queen Elizabeth II Cup came to an end 
for the "genius," Fusaichi Pandora.
And—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah, let's keep this momentum going!

"Then, in a certain GⅠ race that followed, 
Fusaichi Pandora—"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Uh, oh no. My neck kind of hurts!

On the day of the race, she woke up with a 
stiff neck and pulled off a cancellation.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Aaaahn! This is the worst! Ai-chan was 
really looking forward to it, toooo!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Btw, waking up with a stiff neck is crazy 
brutal, right? Like for real, super bad 
luck.

It ended rather anticlimactically, but if 
anything, that's just like her. Above all—

The brilliance shown by Fusaichi Pandora 
that day served as fuel for many of her 
juniors.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, we've got a full lineup of 
promising new stars waiting to debut!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I don't have much confidence, but... I'll 
show that I can do it too!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"I can win, I can win, I can win! After 
all, 'I'm... a genius!'"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And they're off! Leaping from the gates 
all at once, the pack stretches out into a 
long line—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"...―― Now that I've got some free time, 
you know what I'm thinking?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"The very first dream I wanted to make 
come true, I kinda just gave up on it 
midway through, though."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Still, even when a dream comes to an 
end, it connects us to a brand new one.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: And that dream is—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: It will lead to the next dream.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye!! With speed unimaginable for a 
pre-debut, she surges past the field one 
after another!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
What on earth is going to happen to this 
girl...?!?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Towards our next, biiiig dream!♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(...Even that scenery I've dreamed of, if 
it's Ai-chan, I'm sure...)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Almond Eye crosses the finish liiine!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Just kidding♡
